chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.body:
Reading slowly is a *skill*, not a speed setting.[^1] See [the archive](<https://example.org/archive>) for more.

[^1]: Not everyone agrees.

chapters.title: The Method
chapters.body:
## Three habits

• Read aloud.

– Even one page.

• Keep a **pencil** nearby.

• Stop when tired.

## A short table

| Habit | Minutes |
| --- | --- |
| Aloud | 10 |
| Notes | 5 |

Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
